name: card-covered
question: The input has three sections. [CARD] is the requirement card a human holds: what the human wants and the answers the human has settled on. [BLUEPRINT] is what the finished app declares: each app-api with its key, effect, description and input, plus the apps it connects to. [TICKETS] is what the Project Manager wrote as tickets: each ticket's goal and its acceptance check. Decide whether every concrete requirement on the card (each thing the human wants and each settled answer) is carried into the BLUEPRINT (an app-api, an input field, a connection) or into the TICKETS (a goal or an example in an acceptance check). Different wording is fine. Something the card leaves to the agent's recommendation does not need to appear. Verdicts: all = every concrete requirement on the card is present; some_missing = at least one requirement is missing, or is carried in the opposite or a changed form; cannot_tell = the input does not let you decide. The quote must be the part of the input that decided your verdict (for some_missing, the card's words that were lost or changed; for all, the blueprint or ticket part that carries the requirements).
